newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AMP unit raises bid for Equatorial.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AMP unit raises bid for Equatorial.

text.p: Quay Mining Pty Ltd, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Australian Mutual Provident (AMP) Society, said on Friday it has raised its bid for Equatorial Mining NL to 30 cents cash a share from 25 cents.
Quay, which said it was entitled to 34.8 percent of Equatorial shares, also extended the bid to February 27.
Quay said the offer was now free from conditions.
Equatorial Mining is involved in the development of the El Tesoro copper project in Chile which is expected to be in production in late 1998.
